requirements.text: The Department intends to consider a set-aside for service-disabled veteran-owned small businesses verified in SBA VetCert.
Respondents must be registered and active in SAM.gov with NAICS 621399 and a size standard of $9 million.
Respondents must hold a current Joint Commission accreditation or describe an equivalent quality programme.
2.1 The contractor shall provide 42 licensed practical nurses across four medical centres on a 24x7 rotation.
2.2 The contractor shall fill a requested shift within 24 hours of the request 95 percent of the time.
2.3 The contractor must verify licensure, immunisation and credentialing for every clinician before the first shift.
2.4 The contractor shall provide a single point of contact reachable 24 hours a day for scheduling escalations.
2.5 Respondents should describe their approach to clinician retention and the turnover rate achieved on similar contracts.
Capability statements shall not exceed 8 pages including the cover page.
Submit the capability statement as a single PDF named CompanyName_36C10B26SS0113.pdf.
Responses must be emailed to nco10.marketresearch@va.example.gov by 3:00 PM Central Time on 21 October 2026.
Respondents shall state their UEI, CAGE code, socio-economic status and the medical centres they can serve.
The Government will review responses to determine whether adequate SDVOSB capability exists to support a set-aside.
The Government will consider demonstrated experience staffing at least 25 clinicians on a single federal contract.
